A '''skills necklace''' is a [[dragonstone necklace]] that has been enchanted by the [[Lvl-5 Enchant]] spell.

A skills necklace can be recharged at the [[Totem Pole (Legends' Guild)|totem pole]] in the [[Legends' Guild]], at the [[Fountain of Uhld]] in the [[Myths' Guild]], or by casting [[Recharge Dragonstone]], giving it four charges. Players who have completed [[Legends' Quest]] can also recharge it at the [[Fountain of Rune]], giving it six charges.

Like other dragonstone jewellery, it is one the [[Wilderness#Member_teleportation_up_to_level_30_Wilderness|few items]] whose teleports will work up to level 30 Wilderness, while most other means of [[teleport]]ation will not work above level 20 Wilderness.

Wearing a skills necklace with at least one charge while [[Big fishing net|big net]] fishing will slightly increase the chance of finding a [[casket]].{{CiteTwitter|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1574717183888072705|author=Mod Ash|date=27 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99014|archivedate=20 December 2022|quote=Your chance of a casket from big net fishing [while wearing a charged skills necklace] is about 0.4 percentage points higher.}}
